verdict.rationale: Finix documents seller onboarding through its APIs for building a custom flow, plus prebuilt Onboarding Forms for teams that don't want to build the forms, and seller onboarding notifications and webhooks. The specific pieces the story names are not evidenced in the snippets. Missing for 10: explicit KYB/KYC verification details, bank account linking within seller onboarding, terms/agreement acceptance via the API, embeddable (non-hosted) onboarding components, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
